# Exact packages of the CryoAtom v1.0.0 environment (the code of the paper; Python 3.8, Linux x86_64, PyTorch 1.11.0 wheel of PyPI, built for CUDA 10.2).
# CryoAtom v1.0.0 (commit e2a31f2b2ff21fae363490ac5f4a5e945513024c, 2026-01-22): its README installs python 3.8, torch 1.11.0 (CUDA 11.3 build from conda) and the packages that are fixed
# below (numpy 1.21.5, einops 0.6.0, scipy 1.7.3, biopython 1.81, matplotlib 3.5.3, mrcfile 1.4.3, pandas 1.3.5, fair-esm 2.0.0, pyhmmer 0.7.1, torchvision 0.12.0); tqdm, openpyxl, loguru and wget
# (imported by the code) are what pip would pick on 2026-01-29. Deviation: the PyPI wheel of torch 1.11.0 is the CUDA 10.2 build, not the CUDA 11.3 build of conda (same torch version).
#   uv pip compile cryoatom1.in --python-version 3.8 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --exclude-newer 2026-01-29T00:00:00Z --no-annotate
# The notebook installs it with 'uv pip install --no-deps -r' so that nothing else can be pulled in.
